d:
Flix ist ein weltweit führendes Travel Tech Unternehmen, das mit seinen Marken FlixBus, FlixTrain, Greyhound und Kamil Koç jährlich mehr als 60 Millionen Reisenden nachhaltige und erschwingliche Reisen in 43 Ländern anbietet.

Durch die Kombination von Netzplanung, Marketing und Preisgestaltung mit Technologie nutzt Flix innovative Lösungen, um bequemes, nachhaltiges und erschwingliches Reisen weltweit zu ermöglichen und neue Maßstäbe im Reisekomfort und -service zu setzen.

Über unsere Technologieplattform und die benutzerfreundliche App schafft Flix ein auf die Bedürfnisse der Fahrgäste zugeschnittenes Reiseerlebnis und verbindet die Reisenden mit lokalen Buspartnern, die den Transport bereitstellen und eine moderne Flotte mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards gewährleisten.

Dieses einzigartige asset-light Geschäftsmodell hat das europäische Start-up zu einem führenden und weltweit expandierenden Travel-Tech-Champion gemacht.

Flix leistet Pionierarbeit und testet alternative Antriebe mit einer langfristigen Strategie zur schrittweisen Reduzierung des CO2-Ausstoßes seiner Flotte.

Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern und Fahrgäste treiben wir den Wandel hin zur Mobilität der Zukunft voran, indem wir den Mobilitätssektor schrittweise umgestalten und nachhaltigere Reisemöglichkeiten schaffen.

name: Centre For Global Affairs and Public Policy/CGAPP
d:
Centre for Global Affairs and Public Policy (CGAPP) is a non-profit, independent organisation established in 2021, dedicated to advancing interdisciplinary research and action at the intersection of governance, economy, and global affairs.

While rooted in rigorous policy research, CGAPP has evolved to actively bridge the gap between policy design and on-ground implementation. The organisation works closely with local governments and public institutions to address civic challenges through technology-enabled solutions and innovative frameworks, enabling more efficient, scalable, and citizen-centric governance.

CGAPP also plays a catalytic role in supporting impact-driven startups, particularly those operating in sectors such as climate-tech, urban innovation, and public service delivery. Through strategic guidance, ecosystem access, and partnership facilitation, the organisation helps early- and growth-stage ventures navigate complex policy environments and scale sustainably.

A key emerging focus for CGAPP is the creative economy and cities as engines of growth. The organisation explores how urban centres can leverage culture, creativity, and innovation to drive economic development, enhance livability, and foster inclusive growth.

Bringing together a diverse network of academicians, policymakers, industry experts, and practitioners, CGAPP fosters dialogue, collaboration, and knowledge exchange to support evidence-based policymaking and real-world impact. The organisation actively collaborates with national and international institutions to co-create solutions on issues of shared global significance.

name: Zynence
d:
Engineering Intelligence for the Physical World.

Zynence is an AI-native product engineering platform built to transform how physical products are designed, engineered, validated, and brought to manufacturing.

Instead of engineers manually moving between disconnected tools and workflows, Zynence brings an AI engineering workforce of 150+ specialized agents to the product development lifecycle. These agents work together across requirements and system architecture, electronics and PCB design, component selection, BOM and costing, firmware, 3D CAD and mechanical design, simulation, validation, compliance, DFM/DFA, and manufacturing readiness.

Zynence is AI-native across this entire lifecycle. Its agents don't simply assist engineers with documentation or recommendations, they generate and develop engineering artifacts across electronic and mechanical domains, including schematics and PCBs, enclosures and mechanical parts, firmware, engineering documentation, validation plans, and manufacturing outputs.

Underneath this AI engineering layer, deterministic computation handles engineering-critical calculations, while bi-directional traceability connects requirements, components, electronics, firmware, mechanical designs, validation, compliance, and manufacturing, creating a continuously connected engineering system where change can be understood and propagated across the entire product.

The result is a fundamentally different way to build physical products: humans define intent, make critical decisions, and approve. Zynence's AI engineering workforce helps engineer, calculate, validate, trace, and document the product.

Our vision is to make Engineering Intelligence the foundation on which the next generation of physical products is built.

Imagine. Engineer. Validate. Build.

• Detect risks and compliance gaps in real time  
• Ensure alignment with firm-level standards and precedents  
• Move from drafting to decision-making faster  

Xcelro is not just an AI assistant, it is the operating system for legal workflows.

Built for law firms, legal teams, and professionals who want control, clarity, and intelligence in every document.

d:
InstaSpaces is India's largest virtual office and business address network — built to solve one problem that stops more expansions than capital ever does: finding a compliant, verifiable business address fast enough to register for GST, incorporate a company, or open in a new state.

We pioneered virtual offices for GST registration in India, back when the concept barely existed. Since 2016, we've onboarded 104,000+ businesses across all 28 states and 8 union territories — from first-time founders to enterprises like MakeMyTrip, Amazon, Ola, Swiggy, Zomato, and Yatra.

What sets us apart isn't just the address. It's what stands behind it: agreements, NOCs, utility bills, and signage prepared to withstand GST department scrutiny; documentation support through the entire compliance journey — verification, escalation, and query resolution — handled directly by our team, not outsourced. Businesses stay with us for years, some for over a decade, because the address holds up when it's tested.

Our core solutions:

▪️Virtual Office for GST Registration (PPOB & APOB/VPOB)
▪️Company Registration Address
▪️PAN-India Business & Mailing Address
▪️Compliance Documentation Support
▪️Mail & Courier Handling, Call Answering & Forwarding
▪️Meeting Rooms & On-Demand Workspaces

We work directly with e-commerce sellers expanding into new states, D2C brands scaling distribution, freelancers and consultants establishing their first registered presence, and CAs and Company Secretaries who need a partner they can rely on for every client, every time.

ABHICL’s current product portfolio includes unique offerings including chronic care and incentivized wellness.

ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act as a much-needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer-relevant products.  

ABHICL has invested considerable time and effort to understand existing correlations between good health and individual health choices. ABHICL’s product philosophy aims to combine the understanding of this science with an assessment of unaddressed needs of large customer segments, which presently remain unfulfilled. This philosophy can be summed up in 4 simple points - 

•	Rewarding healthy behaviour with incentives that make efforts worthwhile
•	Safeguarding health by guiding customers to manage chronic lifestyle conditions better
•	Protecting health needs with dignity  
•	Providing easy access to a holistic health and wellness ecosystem in a personalized, efficient and cost-effective 
        manner through digitized processes.

name: Sumtracker
d:
Sumtracker is inventory management and replenishment software for Shopify and Amazon merchants, from single-store brands to multi-channel sellers. The platform solves three problems: overselling across channels, stockouts on bestsellers, and overstocking on slow movers. It powers over 2,000 direct-to-consumer brands across 50+ countries, with customers concentrated in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

Sumtracker gives e-commerce brands a single source of truth for their inventory across every store, marketplace, warehouse, and 3PL. It replaces manual stock reconciliation across channels, frees up working capital tied up in dead stock, and helps merchants make data-driven purchasing decisions.

Core capabilities include real-time multi-channel inventory sync, bundle and kit management with component-level tracking, purchase order automation with multi-supplier and multi-currency support, demand forecasting based on historical sales and seasonality, automated replenishment recommendations, stock transfers, stocktakes with barcode scanning, landed cost tracking, and detailed inventory audit trails. Sumtracker integrates natively with Shopify, Shopify Plus, Shopify POS, Amazon (FBA and FBM), Walmart, Etsy, eBay, and QuickBooks, and offers a public REST API for custom integrations.

More than 70% of Sumtracker's customers sell exclusively on Shopify - often across multiple stores — using the platform to get inventory capabilities that Shopify's native tools lack. The remaining customers use Sumtracker for full multi-channel operations across marketplaces.

Sumtracker is featured in Shopify's 2026 guide to the best inventory management software for small business, and holds a 4.8/5 rating on the Shopify App Store with 115+ reviews. Publicly named customers include EasyPlant, Beauty Heroes, Mister Zimi, Bamboo Body, and Whif.

Sumtracker was founded in December 2020 by Ankit Goyal and Kush Goyal, and is bootstrapped and profitable.

Founded in 2011, ReNew is at the forefront of fighting climate change by offering decarbonisation solutions through utility-scale wind and solar offerings, green hydrogen, carbon markets, and energy storage. In 2023, we were recognised among ‘Top 15 Climate Tech Companies to Watch’ by the MIT Technology Review. We are a recipient of the Sustainable Market Initiative’s Terra Carta Seal. The COP28 UAE Presidency presented ReNew the ‘Energy Transition Changemaker’ award for developing and deploying the country’s first round-the-clock power project.

ReNew’s solar and wind energy projects currently contribute to 1.9% of India’s power capacity and are spread across 150+ sites and 18 Indian states. We have helped prevent 0.5% of India’s total carbon emissions and 1.1% of India’s total power sector emissions, in addition to generating around 130,000 jobs over the past decade.

ReNew generated 22+ billion kWh of clean energy during FY25, enough to power over 6 million Indian households annually, and helped avoid 18.6+ million tonnes of carbon emissions.

Across industries, cybercriminals are posing as company recruiters using fake job postings and employment offers to trick people into providing personal information or payment. Be alert and never provide personal/financial information or payment to anyone claiming to offer a job opportunity. During the recruiting process, RSM US will never: 
 
	• Ask you for payment to process documents, purchase equipment, or for any other reason.
	• Request your banking or credit card information
	• Send you a check to purchase your own equipment 
 
If you believe you are a victim of a job scam, it’s recommended that you report it to law enforcement, contact your financial institution and notify the website in which the job was listed.

name: Sphere360io
d:
Sphere exists to make physical commodities risk a shared, enforceable truth — before exposure is taken.

In global commodities markets, trust breaks when decisions are made at a distance from physical reality. Inventory, controls, and risk are inferred from documents and point-in-time checks — often after financing, trading, or insurance decisions are already committed.

Sphere changes this by anchoring where assets exist and what is stored there to physical reality, then enforcing verification before risk, credit, or trading decisions are relied upon.

This foundation is enforced through AI-driven risk models and a governed geospatial matrix that bind location, inventory, verification, and proof into a compounding proof graph anchored to the same physical source of truth.

Sphere does not replace, replicate, or digitise documents. Documents remain where they belong.

Instead, Sphere confirms the existence, relevance, and physical linkage of documents by binding them to verified location, inventory, and evidence — strengthening reliance without redistributing sensitive data.

We establish a single risk baseline, grounded in physical reality, that all participants can independently rely on. Risk only changes when reality changes.

Sphere is not a system of record.

It is the trust layer for physical commodities.
